name: VinDr-PCXR (PhysioNet)
what: 9,125 pediatric frontal chest radiographs from the VinDr hospitals with radiologist boxes; the only sizeable public pediatric spine-bearing radiograph source found
level_truth: none; the pediatric frontal thoracic spine
licence: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data License 1.5.0 (no CITI review needed)
how_to_get: The owner's PhysioNet credentialing (CITI training on file) and the data use agreement on the record page, signed by the owner, the route VinDr-SpineXR took.

Then a recursive wget with the owner's PhysioNet login as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node, as the manifest's vindr_spinexr route does, and sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt on the copy.
An IRB determination before any training reads it, as for VinDr-SpineXR.
